course.name: A2 Grammar: Everyday Accuracy with Nguyen Minh Ha
course.description: A cumulative A2 grammar pilot for accurate everyday communication.

topics.name: Present Simple and Present Continuous
topics.objective: Choose and form the present simple or present continuous for routines, facts, and actions happening now.

topics.name: Past Simple
topics.objective: Describe completed past events with regular verbs and common irregular verbs in affirmative, negative, and question forms.

topics.name: Past Continuous and Interrupted Events
topics.objective: Combine past continuous and past simple to describe an ongoing past action interrupted by another event.

topics.name: Future Plans and Predictions
topics.objective: Use going to and will to express plans, intentions, offers, and simple predictions.

topics.name: Countable and Uncountable Nouns
topics.objective: Classify common nouns and choose some, any, much, many, or a lot of in everyday statements and questions.

topics.name: Comparatives and Superlatives
topics.objective: Compare people, places, and things with comparative and superlative adjectives and common modifiers.

topics.name: Modals for Obligation, Advice, and Permission
topics.objective: Use must, have to, should, can, and could to express rules, advice, requests, and permission.

topics.name: Present Perfect for Experience and Unfinished Time
topics.objective: Use the present perfect for life experience and unfinished time and contrast it with the past simple in clear A2 contexts.
